Just got this app 2 weeks ago after looking for some alternatives to Endel.

The library of music is truly expansive, there’s a vibe for almost everyone.

I’m not diagnosed with ADHD, but I’ve had my suspicions over the last year or so. Turning on ADHD mode in this app makes my mind feel like an engine and it’s humming.

Getting locked in and cranking out code is genuinely fun with this app blessing my ears.

Please take my business!

P.S. Read the recent study on music & ADHD, it’s sick! Linked on their website.
I absolutely love this app overall, but sometimes the app goes totally unresponsive on me and certain features don’t work at all.

Although it’s a little pricey and I’ve had some intermittent issues with the reliability of playback and logging in, customer support made it right. I do find it pretty helpful for getting in the zone when I’m doing video editing or going for a long drive.

I've had trouble focusing on my game development work recently due to some health issues. I found this app and was skeptical that there could be music that helps make focusing easier. I listened to the focus music during some work sessions and thankfully, I was wrong! It actually does help quite a bit with getting my mind back on track with what I'm doing, even after interruptions. If you're on the fence like I was, give it a try at least!
doesn’t do anything 👎👎 also paying for sounds??? rlly

title.label: ADD or ADHD: Get this App

content.label: This app has helped me focus in my grad program hugely! If you have ADD or ADHD listen to the high neural effect playlists and it will have a big impact on your focus. Highly recommend.
App interrupted regular use to ask me to rate app while I was trying to use it—I thought the purpose of this app was to help focus, not distract its users
Having to reach out for support after not using for a stretch is a pain

I’ve tried several of these. This is one of the worst. Everything is just droning, fluttering, and repetitive. Like someone is just holding down one key on a synthesizer for 10 minutes.

Maybe I just don’t get the “science,” but it all seems like snake oil to me. More annoying than any of the designed intentions.

title.label: If you have ADHD, immediately download this app

content.label: This has truly helped so much during times when I need to sit down and focus as well as times I just need to disconnect from the overwhelming dread of life.

I’ve been a supporter of Brain.fm for years. I have been a customer for so long that I don’t remember when this app wasn’t a part of my every day life. No other service compares. It makes my Adderall work double time

Hello, I just started using this app today and I’m in love! I haven’t bought the subscription yet but I certainly will as soon as possible! I got to go to the store first. I don’t really know where to begin. They have like everything. So many sounds and compositions. So many moods and even more ambience. I tried this with the intent of using it with my business… and now I want my family to use it for everything. Forget traditional music… this! This! So much variety! Just WOW! Beyond impressed! This is what I didn’t know I was missing.
I LOVE Brain.fm but I like to use my headphones with my computer and have my phone put away. PLEASE make an app for the Microsoft store. It will help so many people!!

title.label: Some tracks amazing but app needs work

content.label: App is confusing and way too complicated. Every update makes finding my Downloads and favorites difficult.

I don’t know how anyone has rated this app with anything but one star. I’m neurodivergent on multiple levels so maybe my ears are just more sensitive, but the “focus” sound in the background was physically painful to my ears, even at a low volume. This app has great reviews and I truly don’t know how. The sound was piercing - maybe if the speed at which it oscillates went down by at least 500% it wouldn’t bother me. But it felt like someone was driving an icepick into my eardrums.

For example, I was feeling tired from a night of waking up constantly. I put my headphones on, selected focus, and started making breakfast for my son. With the timer going for visual aid, I turned a mundane task into something that only took minutes. Then cleaned dirty dishes and organized my fridge. Once I was done the timer said 59 minutes. Before I would have dragged it out to hours. This is a great new tool discovered on a Justin Sung YouTube video to study with him.

title.label: I use this app every day.

content.label: I honestly still don’t know how “real” the science of it is. All I know is that I like the music and I find that it really works. I use almost all of the settings and I find that they really do aid and benefit whatever task I am trying to accomplish whether it’s creative writing, meditating, calming down for bedtime, or my personal favorite “light work” for those mindless, tedious administrative tasks that can be so boring. I am very easily distracted and for whatever reason when I have Brain FM going, I stay locked in to whatever task I set out to do. The timers are also super helpful. I can’t wait for them to add more songs and genres.

Listen, categorize, personalize & remember to utilize! Your ease, focus and desires will arrive.

Amituofo

title.label: Helpful sometimes but not worth the cost

content.label: I used this app mostly at night to see if it would help me sleep through the night better. I wouldn’t say it helped with that any better than anything else I’ve tried. I still woke up at the same time I always do and couldn’t go back to sleep, even with the “assistance “ of the app. I do think the focus playlists are helpful, the times I tried them seemed to work. But I can only use it when nobody else is around because it just contributes to the overstimulating noise pollution if anything else is happening around me. Definitely not worth the monthly cost. Maybe if it was a one time fee or a lower monthly price.

Great way to focus on your tasks while you listen to some music playing in the background. This reminds me of when i was school the teacher use to play classical music to help us focus. This app is the upgraded version.

This helped me become the most focused I have ever been in my
 life.

I have enjoyed MindPump for many years.  When they recommend something, I’ll look into it and check it out. They had high praise for this app. I specifically wanted to try it for sleep as I’ve had issues  for years off and on. On multiple occasions I tried the deep sleep option during the 2 wk trial. I have come to the conclusion that this app is complete nonsense. At the least, it didn’t work for me at all. My advise:  don’t waste your time and certainly not your money.

Not Recommended - like the music and settings. It worked for about a week. Now when opening, it takes me to the free trial - sign up, and won’t allow access even though the settings show a paid membership to February 2026. I would likely use this often, especially for focus. I sent feedback and they replied that someone would contact me. Never happened. Don’t waste your money. Andy C.

As a medical student, I always struggled with maintaining focus during long study sessions. Ever since I started using this app, my concentration and productivity have skyrocketed. I only wish I had discovered it sooner—it has completely transformed the way I study. Highly recommended for anyone looking to improve their focus and efficiency!

Bluetooth issues. Connecting from my phone to any speaker, there is lots of popping and cracking sounds. Contacted support and they basically said “that’s odd.”  I asked for a refund, they said I have to ask Apple. I try to ask Apple and it said it’s no longer eligible for a refund. I bought a year’s subscription. Do yourself a favor and if you want to try this app just subscribe monthly to make sure it works, because there is no support.
This is my favorite app to work. First thing to do every day
It’s always been hard for me to sit down and focus so that I could study or practice but having this in my ear in the focus section my brain is just dialed in. Buy this app it’ll change your life.

I enjoyed using the app but their customer service is abysmal. I renewed my annual subscription on the App Store. Whenever I try to load the app and play music, the app tries to get me to sign up for a new trial. I already have a subscription!  I’ve emailed their support 4 times and received no response. Submitted a refund request to Apple subscriptions

I mostly love this app. It helps with my sleep and focus. I have major ADHD and for the most part I can function. 

My only complaint is there’s this fluttery sound that is on almost every track some days. And I can not get past it. I wish there was a way to turn it off

title.label: It’s one of the single most important productivity tools I use

content.label: It doesn’t just help you focus, it breaks it down by type of focus. It’s easier to reach a state of flow with creative focus. It’s the only way I can achieve true deep work. Plus, there’s meditation, sleepy music to get the kids to bed and so many options. I’m a better version of me with it.

As a person with ADHD trying to manage their daily life, career, family, etc., I use this app when I need to focus on deep work and it really helps me to stay on task. I also use the app at night for sleep, and occasionally do the guided meditation when my energy slumps in the afternoon. Well worth the price.

Absolutely love this app. Found it off a podcast and gave it a shot. I can noticeably tell a difference with both focus and relaxation/sleep. Have not tried meditation. 

I’ve been using this for 46 weeks according to my streak tracker. I’ve likely used sleep every single night. 

I have recommended this to so many people I should be representative at this point lol
I use this any time I read and its been an absolute cheat code
I’ve been using the Focus and Sleep sections for a couple weeks.  Seems to work really well.  I do with there was an Apple TV version so I could put the Focus music over my tv audio system.

As a college student I couldn’t recommend this app more. I have trouble focusing and this app helps me so much getting my tasks done while also feeling relaxed. Also great place to meditate if you want to ditch the random videos on youtube.
I use this for work, sleeping, and relaxing. I really like that you can favourite songs.

This app has exceeded my expectations.  I originally bought it for my son, who is a convert to this concept, to help him focus during studies. I decided to try it out because other apps have failed when it comes to helping me stay asleep at night. 

I can’t believe how many more hours of sleep I’m getting in the deep sleep mode.  Waking upon tossing and turning used to mean I couldn’t go back to sleep for an hour or two.   I also have been using it during waking hours to be energized upon getting out of bed. 

Functionalities in this app don’t even compare to other sleep apps that I’ve used. I didn’t realize how much I would love, as my son does, to be able to create a library of music specific to my particular taste in genres for certain modes.  But that’s just the icing on the cake.   Most people would likely be satisfied with just simply liking or disliking a particular track that the program chooses for you based on the ‘task’ you’re choosing.

I’ve turned a friend on to this app who has trouble falling asleep and she raves about that functionality.    Love, love, love!!!

I answered the questions for preferences and the music it played grates on my nerves. No way to change preferences. Deleted 10 minutes in. Good concept, but not with with an app that is not user friendly.
Paid only. Nothing is free.

This was recommended to me by an ADHDer who swore by it.
I’ve used a lot of different binaural soundscapes. Usually I don’t believe in the legitimacy of them but for some reason this one helps me focus when I need to do my morning pages and regular writing. 
I like how it lets you easily skip to another track if the one being offered to you isn’t helpful / too distracting.
I love the deep work option and I’ve tried the section to help with sleep- but the deep work (inside the focus section) is the best. 
My noise canceling headphones died so I’ve been just playing this through my phone speakers- even then it still works (although I prefer the headphones- after I’ve been listening to anything on brain FM while wearing headphones as soon as I take them off, there is a noticeable “pop” in my ears- like I’ve just changed altitude)
A friend of mine had a headache and this app helped lessen its intensity. If you want a shortcut into flow state, then brain.fm is your friend. Worth the money!
Title says it all, I listen to brain fm throughout my day.

I’ve never been diagnosed or medicated by realized after struggling for year in school that I must have ADHD. I struggled through college and was working through my Masters in seminary when I was starting to hit a wall of losing my focus when I needed it more than ever. I discovered this app from my brother and it made the difference. The more I’ve used it over the past two years the more effective it gets. Because of this I’m not even considering getting prescribed for ADHD, this music is doing the trick with different kinds for a variety of different tasks!

title.label: Great for meditation and deep focus

content.label: I’ve only been using the app for a few days and could tell immediately that I had increased sustained attention. I’ve used it to meditate and really find the guided meditations soothing and a lovely addition to my practice. The music is similar to binaural beats but is different in that it targets 3 regions of the brain and headphones are not required, to name a few. I highly recommend the app to those who need help focusing and getting yourself in certain deep work or flow states.

I never thought music could get my brain to work, and you are fair to question it, but the effectivity you get out of this app is amazing, you could be sick with a headache or back from work and then voila! After 5 minutes you’re in focus and you are ready to go. I personally bought the yearly plan, and this is more then worth it, you can do way more with brain.fm and I 100% recommend it, just try the free trial and then figure out the joy you get!
My job requires a lot of highly technical reading and writing. This music helps me pay attention for hours on end
I am highly sensitive to sounds and the helicopter whirring sound is intense and stress inducing. I’m going to give it a chance to see if I can get used to it… but yikes.
The music is just so fire, helps me stay focused and it’s so pleasant and stimulating. Every time I use it I get reminded how good it is!

I've been using this app for about six months, and it helps so much. The broad range of music is terrific, and helps with focus more than I thought possible. The best thing to listen to on days when I have a lot to do.
